notes: Read 25 Nov 2026. All figures are revenue (or production value) ÷ area from the cited filing or statistic, or a per-m² price the filing states; none estimated. Thailand: KCE's own Q3-2026 MD&A (Table 5) gives USD sales and sq ft shipped by layer class for FY2025 and each quarter - the best non-China source: FY2025 2L 98.6, 4L 120.8, 6L+ 162.9, HDI ('special grade') 190.4, all 141.4 USD/m²; 3Q26 (after 2026 price increases) 4L 133.7, 6L+ 181.9, HDI 218.1, all 158.4 USD/m². Apex International (Thailand-only plant, consumer/communications/computer/auto) multilayer 3,087 TWD/m² (≈ USD 99) in 2023. Japan: METI Current Production Statistics 2025 (national, all producers in Japan): 2-layer 27,358 JPY/m², 4-layer 39,063, 6-8 layer 110,711, 10+ layer 339,547, build-up/HDI 203,063 JPY/m². These are PRODUCTION VALUE per m² (METI '生産金額'), not invoiced ASP, and cover all end markets. At ~150 JPY/USD: 4L ≈ USD 260/m², 6-8L ≈ USD 740/m² - Japanese domestic output is small-lot / high-reliability and much dearer than Thai or Chinese volume boards. South Korea: DAP (Anseong + Ansan plants, 52% automotive, HDI-heavy) states 427,958 KRW/m² for 2024 (≈ USD 314/m²); ISU Petasys (Daegu, AI/network high-layer MLB, not automotive) 3.74 M KRW/m²; Daeduck / Simmtech / Korea Circuit are substrate-heavy and only references. Taiwan: only consolidated group figures (Chin-Poon: Taiwan + Changshu China + Thailand, automotive-led): double-sided + multilayer 5,218 TWD/m² in 2023 (≈ USD 168/m²), 4,776 in 2022. India: IL JIN DRHP (Nov 2026): Ascent Circuits (Hosur) FY2025 ₹7,508/m² and the Ascent + Shogini vertical FY2026 ₹9,512/m² - revenue ÷ PRODUCTION area (sales area not disclosed), mixed single/double/multilayer/metal-clad/flex. The DRHP's industry section also gives Indian bare-PCB DEMAND (85% imported) ₹152.96 bn for 21.2 M m² in FY2025 (≈ ₹7,215/m²) - that is a market-price for mostly imported boards, not a made-in-India price, so it is not recorded as an item. China cross-checks (2025 annual reports): Olympic Circuit 1,062.6 CNY/m² (all PCBs, automotive-led), Ellington/依顿 830.0 CNY/m² (automotive largest share) - same order as the Chaoying 4-6L figure (995 CNY/m²). Caveats: (1) product mix dominates - HDI / high-layer shares and substrates move averages by 2-10×; (2) USD conversions in 'arithmetic' use approximate annual-average FX not taken from the documents; (3) KCE's figures are 'PCB sales @ factory price'; Apex/Chin-Poon area is m² sold; DAP/Daeduck/Simmtech/Korea Circuit state their own per-m² prices; India uses production area; Japan is production value; (4) a 2022 broker table for KCE (FSSIA, USD 13.8/sq ft) is kept for history only.
